comment: Entries the runs of results/logins-2026-11-17 would add to observed/manifest.json (T-74, branch campaign/logins). limits: the 13 rows replace existing rows; the claude-fable-5-2 row is new. runs: appended to runs. limits: each REPLACES the existing row of the same route, client and model (one row each). excluded: appended to excluded. Nothing here is a result: build_observed.py computes them from the raw files.

runs.note: plain probe through CLIProxyAPI pinned to the Codex login (temporary alias probe/gpt-6.1-sol).
